title: Degree: ほど, くらい, あまり(に), ば〜ほど, ほど〜ない, につれて, 一方だ
description: To the extent that, at least, so … that, the more … the more, not as … as, as … changes, and 'keeps getting more'.

points.title: 〜ほど: to the extent that, so … that
points.summary: Verb/noun + ほど + predicate = to such a degree that. Often exaggerated: 死ぬほど, 山ほど.
points.body:
- 死ぬ**ほど**疲れた (so tired I could die).
- 山**ほど**宿題がある (a mountain of homework).
- 涙が出る**ほど**笑った.

ほど expresses a high degree. **くらい** can often replace it, but ほど sounds stronger and is used for exaggeration.
examples: {死|し}ぬほど{疲|つか}れた。
I'm dead tired.
{山|やま}ほど{宿題|しゅくだい}がある。
I have tons of homework.

points.title: 〜くらい / ぐらい: at least, to the extent of (minimum)
points.summary: Noun + くらい = 'at least …' (a minimum that's easy): 挨拶くらいしなさい. Also degree like ほど, but more modest.
points.body:
- せめて挨拶**くらい**してください (at least say hello).
- 自分のこと**くらい**自分でやりなさい (do at least your own things yourself).

The 'at least / something as small as' meaning belongs to くらい — ほど can't do this.
examples: せめて{挨拶|あいさつ}くらいしてください。
At least say hello.
{自分|じぶん}のことくらい{自分|じぶん}でやりなさい。
At least do your own things yourself.

points.title: あまりに(も) / 〜のあまり: so (much) … that
points.summary: あまりに + adjective + て = so … that (a bad result). Noun + のあまり = out of (excessive) ….
points.body:
- **あまりに**忙しくて、昼ご飯を食べる時間もなかった.
- 驚き**のあまり**、声も出なかった (I was so surprised I couldn't speak).

Don't confuse with **あまり〜ない** (not very) from N4.
examples: あまりに{忙|いそが}しくて、{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べる{時間|じかん}もなかった。
I was so busy I didn't even have time for lunch.
{驚|おどろ}きのあまり、{声|こえ}も{出|で}なかった。
I was so surprised I couldn't make a sound.

points.title: 〜ば〜ほど: the more … the more
points.summary: ば-form + same word (dictionary form) + ほど = the more A, the more B.
points.body:
- 練習すれ**ば**練習する**ほど**、上手になる.
- 考えれ**ば**考える**ほど**、わからなくなる.
- 安けれ**ば**安い**ほど**いい.

The same verb/adjective is repeated: ば-form first, then dictionary form + ほど. な-adj: 静か**なら**静かな**ほど**.
examples: {練習|れんしゅう}すればするほど、{上手|じょうず}になる。
The more you practise, the better you get.

points.title: AはBほど〜ない: A is not as … as B
points.summary: Noun + ほど + negative = not as … as. Used to say something is *less* than the comparison.
points.body:
- 今年の夏は去年**ほど**暑く**ない** (this summer isn't as hot as last year).
- 私は兄**ほど**背が高く**ない**.

Always negative. (より works in positive comparisons: 去年より暑い.)
examples: {今年|ことし}の{夏|なつ}は{去年|きょねん}ほど{暑|あつ}くない。
This summer isn't as hot as last year.

points.title: 〜につれて: as … (changes), so …
points.summary: Dictionary form / noun + につれて = as A changes, B changes along with it.
points.body:
- 年をとる**につれて**、体が弱くなる.
- 時間がたつ**につれて**、町の様子が変わっていった.

Both A and B are gradual changes. Similar: 〜とともに, 〜に従って.
examples: {年|とし}をとるにつれて、{体|からだ}が{弱|よわ}くなる。
As you get older, your body gets weaker.

points.title: 〜一方だ: keeps getting more and more
points.summary: Dictionary form + 一方だ = a trend that keeps going in one direction (usually negative).
points.body:
- 最近、物価は上がる**一方だ** (prices keep going up).
- 人口は減る**一方だ**.

Not to be confused with **一方で** ('on the other hand').
examples: {最近|さいきん}、{物価|ぶっか}は{上|あ}がる{一方|いっぽう}だ。
Lately prices just keep rising.

questions.prompt: {昨日|きのう}は{死|し}ぬ（　）{疲|つか}れた。
notes: 死ぬばかり isn't a degree expression.

questions.prompt: {今週|こんしゅう}は{山|やま}（　）{宿題|しゅくだい}がある。
notes: しか needs a negative verb.
questions.translation: I have tons of homework this week.

questions.prompt: {忙|いそが}しくても、せめて{挨拶|あいさつ}（　）してください。
questions.translation: Even if you're busy, at least say hello.

questions.prompt: {自分|じぶん}のこと（　）{自分|じぶん}でやりなさい。
notes: まで = 'even' — sounds like an extreme.
questions.translation: At least do your own things yourself.

questions.prompt: （　）{忙|いそが}しくて、{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べる{時間|じかん}もなかった。
questions.explanation: So … that (bad result): **あまりに** + adjective + て.
notes: あまり alone needs a negative (あまり忙しくない).
めったに needs a negative.
ちっとも needs a negative.
questions.translation: I was so busy I didn't even have time for lunch.

questions.prompt: {驚|おどろ}きの（　）、{声|こえ}も{出|で}なかった。
notes: 驚きのくらい isn't grammatical.
のあまりに isn't the standard pattern.
驚きのほど isn't idiomatic here.
questions.translation: I was so surprised I couldn't make a sound.

questions.prompt: {練習|れんしゅう}すれ（　）{練習|れんしゅう}する（　）、{上手|じょうず}になる。
notes: すれたら isn't a form.
questions.translation: The more you practise, the better you get.

questions.prompt: {考|かんが}えれば（　）ほど、わからなくなる。
questions.explanation: The second part is the **dictionary form** + ほど.
questions.translation: The more I think about it, the less I understand.

questions.prompt: {今年|ことし}の{夏|なつ}は{去年|きょねん}（　）{暑|あつ}くない。
questions.translation: This summer isn't as hot as last year.

questions.prompt: What does 「このかばんはあのかばんほど{高|たか}くない」 mean?
options: This bag is cheaper than that bag.
This bag is more expensive than that bag.
questions.explanation: AはBほど〜ない = A is **less** … than B.
notes: ほど〜ない says they're not the same.
It says nothing about whether *that* bag is expensive — only that this one is less so.

questions.prompt: {年|とし}をとる（　）、{体|からだ}が{弱|よわ}くなる。
questions.translation: As you get older, your body gets weaker.

questions.prompt: {時間|じかん}がたつ（　）、{町|まち}の{様子|ようす}が{変|か}わっていった。
notes: につれた can't connect here.
につれない isn't the pattern.
につれる can't connect to the next clause.
questions.translation: As time passed, the town changed.

questions.prompt: {最近|さいきん}、{物価|ぶっか}は{上|あ}がる（　）だ。
notes: 一方で = 'on the other hand' — can't end with だ.

questions.prompt: What does 「{人口|じんこう}は{減|へ}る{一方|いっぽう}だ」 mean?
options: On the other hand, the population decreases.
questions.explanation: 一方だ = a continuing one-way trend.
notes: That would be 一度減った.
That would be 減るかもしれない.
